newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lucent sees double digit '96 revenue growth.
newsitem.headline: Lucent sees double digit '96 revenue growth.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc expects to report double digit revenue growth in 1996 and to meet or exceed its earnings target in the third quarter of this year, David Johnson, regional vice president, business communication, Lucent Technologies Aisa Pacific and China, said on Tuesday.
"We will have double-digit growth in 1996," said Johnson, adding that Lucent had revenue of US$21.4 billion in 1995.
"We are ahead of our plan on earnings. We will soon be reporting third quarter with the expectation to meet or exceed targeted earnings," he added.
Lucent went public in April at US$27 per share. The stock closed on Monday at US$45-7/8. "We fully expect the stock to continue moving in a positive way," Johnson said.
Johnson provided nine-month figures for the company. He said revenue year-to-date was US$17.37 billion compared to US$15.51 billion in the same 1995 period.
